name: Eliza
source:
An “artificial goddess” android created by the scientist Jean Regulus. Her mind was uploaded from autonomous will first discovered in SHEEP.

Since she excels at loving conversations, she oversees the online mental care of Battleship Baobab’s residents as their foremost psychiatrist.

Her ageless, eternal beauty is an inspiration to many a Baobabian woman. She and Wolf are close companions. Literally doesn’t have a heart.

[i]“You’re right… All I can do is learn from humans’ conversations and repeat the most apt words.”[/i]

[From [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/3312]Shiravune[/url]]
